android.desc:
Are your best discounts buried in your inbox, lost in your camera roll, or forgotten in a junk drawer? Don’t let your hard-earned savings expire. CouponVault is designed specifically for the unique, personal coupons that belong to you.

YOUR PERSONAL COUPON MANAGER

CouponVault helps you organize all your coupons in one secure place. Whether it's a birthday discount, a promotional code from an event, or a receipt with a future discount - never let another coupon go to waste.

KEY FEATURES

SCAN & STORE

SYNC ACROSS DEVICES                                                                                                               
• Access your coupons on all your devices
• Automatic cloud backup keeps your data safe
• Switch between phone and tablet seamlessly
• Your coupons are always up-to-date

SHARE WITH FAMILY & FRIENDS
• Share specific coupons with others
• Create sharing lists for family members
• Collaborate on savings with your household
• Help friends save money too

NEVER MISS SAVINGS
• Set expiration dates and get reminders
• Mark coupons as used or archived
• Filter and search instantly
• Sort by category, store, or expiration date


Unlike other coupon apps that only show public deals, CouponVault is YOUR personal vault for the unique coupons YOU receive - birthday discounts, loyalty rewards, event promotions, and personalized offers that aren't found anywhere else.

Whether you're organizing coupons from:
• Birthday celebration gift cards
• Store loyalty programs
• Event promotional codes
• Email marketing offers
• Physical receipts with discounts
• Friend referral bonuses

CouponVault keeps them all safe, organized, and accessible when you need them most.

quotes.text:
I'm working on CouponVault

The story behind this app that I get a lot of giftcards - birthdays, holidays, a lot of special  - and by the time I'm pretty sure that a lot of them got lost

Because I didn't find any good place that I can store those giftcards over there I decided to create one

So what this app can do?

• Access your coupons on all your devices

• Automatic cloud backup keeps your data safe

• Switch between phone and tablet seamlessly

• Share specific coupons with others

• Create sharing lists for family members

• Set expiration dates and get reminder.

• Mark coupons as used or archived

• Filter and search instantly

• Sort by category, store, or expiration date

The app is designed to be offline-first, so if you afraid of storing your coupons online, you can use the app offline and all of your data will stay in your device (sharing functionality will be disabled)

Give it a try and let me know what you think!

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sasm.couponvault
